annotation.title_clean: 介護ロボットの効果的な活用のための手引き
annotation.title_en: Guide to the Effective Use of Nursing-Care Robots
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 株式会社三菱総合研究所 (Mitsubishi Research Institute) for MHLW commissioned project
annotation.venue: MHLW Roken project report (老人保健健康増進等事業)
annotation.summary_en: Japanese practical handbook (March 2019, commissioned by MHLW, prepared by Mitsubishi Research Institute) for care facilities adopting nursing-care robots. It covers 13 device categories, costs, environment setup, safety notes, facility testimonials, and a staged adoption and evaluation process, supported by METI/AMED subsidy programmes.
key_provisions_or_claims: Defines nursing-care robots via sensing, judgment and actuation, across 6 fields and 13 priority device categories.
Recommends a four-stage adoption process: review, preparation, trial, operation, with evaluation indicators.
Safety notes: safety first, halt use if danger is sensed, select suitable users, check devices.
Privacy cautions for camera/sensor monitoring and cloud care data; family consent needed.
Lists prefectural subsidy contacts and showcase facilities for robot adoption support.
